conf.description: FireEye CM console audit, syslog-raw: standard syslog-envelope regex_extract only (timestamp, hostname); the appliance-specific message-body grammar is undocumented anywhere in this work order and is deliberately left unsplit in fireeye.cm.audit_detail rather than guessed.

conf.comment: fireeye/cm-audit/syslog-raw. This work order gives NO captured example line, NO literal delimiter or keyword for the message body, and explicitly instructs 'confirm what the audit lines actually look like before pinning extraction patterns' and 'build extraction patterns from captured lines... not from documentation' -- unlike every other block in this batch, there is no public reference or documented column layout to fall back on either. This pipeline therefore parses only the standard syslog envelope (timestamp, hostname), which is genuinely bounded to a small set of well-known variants, and leaves the ENTIRE message body in fireeye.cm.audit_detail unsplit. user.name, source.ip, event.action and event.outcome are deliberately left unmapped -- extracting them would mean guessing a token grammar with zero evidence, which the brief explicitly forbids. See README.

functions.description: document the total-grammar-unknown gap and the envelope-only parse

split the standard syslog envelope (optional PRI, BSD or RFC5424-style timestamp, hostname) from the appliance-specific message body, which is left whole because its internal grammar is not documented anywhere in this work order

parse the envelope timestamp with a best-effort explicit-UTC suffix (approximation -- BSD-style timestamps carry no year or zone, and this is not a verified fix), and copy the unsplit message body into the one custom field this work order actually names, before rename
batch-rename the one status:mapped field that needs no further transform
tag event.dataset and drop the raw envelope-timestamp and message-remainder keys fully consumed above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
